description: This file defines a JavaScript class RGraph.CSV that provides functionality for loading, parsing, and manipulating CSV data within the RGraph charting library. It includes methods for fetching CSV data from URLs or DOM elements, splitting CSV lines with custom logic, and retrieving specific rows or columns.

classes.name: RGraph.CSV
classes.description: A class for fetching and parsing CSV data, supporting custom separator and line-ending characters, and providing methods to access specific rows or columns.

methods.name: splitCSV(str, split)
methods.description: A custom CSV splitting function that handles quoted fields and preserves whitespace based on options.

methods.name: fetch()
methods.description: Fetches CSV data from a URL or DOM element, parses the data into an array, and invokes the ready callback.

methods.name: getRow(index)
methods.description: Returns a specific row from the CSV data, optionally starting from a specific column index.

methods.name: getColumn
methods.description: Returns a specific column from the CSV data, optionally starting from a specific row index.
